note: Note that the first character is selected by default, so when you start the workflow the image of the first character will be described and played.

5 at this point reoect from step 3

5. Cormac Stonefist (Gnome) 
Cormac Stonefist is a stout gnome standing at about 3 feet tall, with a round face and bright green eyes that sparkle with mischief. His wild grey hair sticks out in every direction, giving him a perpetually tousled look. He has a small nose and a wide, cheerful grin that can light up a room.

Male

Cormac wears a pair of worn leather breeches, a loose-fitting white shirt with billowy sleeves, and a faded brown cloak with intricate embroidery depicting scenes of gnomish engineering marvels. Around his neck, he wears a silver pendant shaped like a miniature gearwheel, symbolizing his love for tinkering and inventing.

Cormac wields a trusty short sword adorned with tiny gears and cogs, which he uses to defend himself in times of need. In his belt pouch, he carries a set of lockpicks, a small hammer, and various other tools for his trade as a tinkerer and inventor. When not adventuring, Cormac can often be found in his workshop, surrounded by half-built contraptions and scraps of metal, lost in thought as he tries to solve the latest puzzle or design a new gadget.

1. Kaelith Sunshadow (Elf) Kaelith Sunshadow is a slender and agile elf with piercing emerald green eyes and shoulder-length golden hair that falls in loose waves down her back. Her skin has a warm, sun-kissed glow from spending countless hours under the open sky. She stands at about 5'8" with a lean yet athletic build, honed from years of climbing trees and traversing treacherous landscapes. Her ears are slightly pointed, a trait common among elves, and her nose is small and straight. A delicate silver circlet adorns her brow, bearing the symbol of her family crest.

Kaelith is a female. She wears a flowing white tunic made of lightweight silk, cinched at the waist by a leather belt adorned with tiny gemstones. Her leggings are a deep shade of indigo, matching the color of her eyes, and are made of a supple material that allows for ease of movement. Around her neck, she wears a delicate chain bearing a small crystal pendant that glows softly in the dark. On her feet, she wears soft deerskin boots with intricate stitching along the seams. In her hand, she wields a longbow crafted from a single piece of yew wood, its limbs adorned with small feathers and gemstones. At her side hangs a quiver filled with arrows fletched with owl feathers and tipped with razor-sharp obsidian points.
